scenes.name: purpose
scenes.heading:
Push your hardware.
Prove the result.
scenes.narration: Explore what your hardware can really do. Balance speed, memory and cost, while keeping task quality in view.

scenes.heading: Start with your task.
scenes.narration: Choose a model, add representative examples, and set your quality and resource limits. Start with a baseline you can measure.

scenes.heading:

scenes.name: architecture
scenes.heading:
One engine.
Multiple ways to work.
scenes.narration: One shared application engine connects the visual workspace, command line and MCP interface. Python coordinates workflows, while an optional Rust supervisor manages model processes.

scenes.name: routing
scenes.heading:
Your priorities.
Your model choices.
scenes.narration: Route agents using your priorities. Calibrate on scored tasks, reuse exact responses, and unload idle models to recover memory.

scenes.heading:
Describe. Build.
Test. Refine.
scenes.narration: Describe a solution with your chosen model. Review the changes, then build and test a disposable copy in Docker, with bounded repair loops.

scenes.heading:

models with Soup.
scenes.narration: Use Soup to train task adapters, reload them, and compare results. Keep held-out evaluations separate, so smaller models still have to prove their value.
